verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the enterprise page listing "regional code hosting" among Enterprise features. That is a first-party residency control, but it covers code only, appears tier-gated, and gets a single thin mention with no explanation of how a region is chosen. missing for 10: documented region selection for app data (Cloud database, storage, auth), details on available regions and how to select them, availability outside Enterprise, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
